name: vault-assistant
description: The workflow bundle for people who keep a personal Obsidian vault: set it up (vault-setup), write notes one way (vault-conventions), run projects from charter to archive (vault-project, vault-resume, vault-capture), curate (vault-promote, vault-tidy), and keep a rhythm of plans and a morning note (vault-planning, vault-daily), and learn and keep the owner's rules (rulebook, rule-learner, rule-steward). Needs the external obsidian@obsidian-skills plugin and the company memory
